Okay okay I know this folder is supposedly "clean code" but whateva

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
data <- read.csv("../../Data/full_dataset.csv")

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Inoculation = factor(Inoculation),
    Polyculture = factor(Polyculture),
    Water       = factor(Water),   # alphabetical sort already gives
                                     # Control, Moderate, Severe - the
                                     # sensible low-to-high stress order.
    Group       = interaction(Inoculation, Polyculture, sep = "_")
  )

# This is "Total pot productivity" (Pot_NPP_g, the per-pot version) x the
# Inoculation:Polyculture interaction - p_adj = 0.0685, "Kinda (<.1)".
# Flipped orientation: x = Polyculture, color = Inoculation.

# 1. group means + standard error
summary_df <- data %>%
  group_by(Polyculture, Inoculation) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_y = mean(Pot_NPP_g, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_y   = sd(Pot_NPP_g, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Pot_NPP_g))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. the plot itself
p <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Polyculture, y = mean_y,
                             color = Inoculation, group = Inoculation)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 6) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_y - se_y, ymax = mean_y + se_y), width = 0.15) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title    = element_blank(),
        legend.text     = element_text(size = 5),
        legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"),
        legend.margin   = margin(t = -4)) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(subtitle = "p = 0.068  .") +
  theme(
    axis.title    = element_blank(),
    plot.margin   = margin(1, 1, 1, 1),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 5.5, face = "plain", colour = "grey40",
                                  hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 1))
  )

p
```
